༄༅/ /nam mkha'i sad srung nyi zla 'od sprin gyi lo glud zab mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// nam mkha'i sad srung nyi zla 'od sprin gyi lo glud zab mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

nam mkha'i sad srung nyi zla 'od sprin gyi lo glud bgegs kyi rgyal po gdong lnga pa'i gtso byas 'gong po sde dgu dang bcas pa rnams la gtong bar bya'o// zhes sad srung lag tu len pa ni/ rin po che'i snod du 'bru sna'i phye ma la mi gzugs/ gdong dbus ma mi/ g.yas phag /g.yon spre'u/ rgyab rta/ steng bya ste gdong lnga pa zhig bca'o// de la 'gong po sde dgu mi lus can dgu yis bskor/ de dag gi mthar gtor ma/ mar me/ chang bu/ mtheb skyu/ ril bu rnams dgus bskor/ de la lo 'bras rnams kyi sngo phud/ chang*/ zho// 'o ma/ ja mar/ sha khrag |rus pa la sogs gza' btung gi rigs ci 'byor dang*/ dar zab/ 'bru sna/ rin chen la sogs pa bran nas/ mdun du stegs gyi khar bzhag ste/ rang yi dam kyi nga rgyal la gnas pas/ sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin brlabs nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las khro bo khro mo lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros pas/ bgegs kyi rgyal po gdong lnga pa/ 'gong po sde dgu la sogs pa 'bras bu lo thog la sad kyi gnod pa gtong ba'i gnod byed pho rgyud mo*/rgyud klu rgyud gsum gyis bsdus pa gang yin pa sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i srid par 'khod pa de dag thams cad kyi snying nas lcags kyus bzung*/ mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcings/ yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams/ dril bus dbang du bsdus te bkug la/ mdun gyi gzugs rnams la thim par gyur cig ces bsam la/ bden stobs ci mang brjod pas bkug la/ na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed yab yum sras sprul 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ dbang drag pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa sogs yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/

dpal ye shes kyi mgon po dang*/ a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma sogs chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos nyid rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa chen po'i mthus lo tog la gnod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi rgyal po gdong lnga pa/ 'gong po sde dgu la sogs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud klu rgyud gsum gyis bsdus pa gang yin pa/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i srid par 'khod pa de dag thams cad skad cig rang dbang med par mdun gyi gzugs 'di la khug cig /hūm̐ */ nga ni sangs rgyas nga ni chos// nga ni dge 'dun nga ni lha// bgegs chen ma rungs gdong lnga pa// 'gong po sde dgu'i 'khor gyis bskor// gnod byed sad 'dre 'byung po rnams// thams cad nga yi ngag la nyon/ kye/ sangs rgyas gsung la mi nyan med// dam pa'i chos la mi sems med// dge 'dun tshogs la mi gus med// nam mkha'i 'og la mi gnas med// sa gzhi'i steng du mi 'khor med// dal 'gro'i chu la mi 'thung med// skya ring lam la mi 'gro med// zas dang skom la mi brten med// srog la mi gces su yang med// bshags na mi 'tsheng gang yang med// nor rdzas mi phangs su yang med// 'jam pa'i ngag la mi nyan med// de nas sngags 'chang bdag cag gis// lus can rnams la phan pa dang*// dbul phongs mu ge 'joms pa'i phyir// 'bras drug sad las skyob par gyis/ sad 'dre bgegs chen ma rungs pa// 'gong po sde dgu'i tshogs kyi 'khor// pho rgyud mo rgyud klu rgyud la// ma gtogs bgegs chen de dag kun// zhi ba'i sems kyis brngan pa'i phyir// 'bru sna lnga yi gtor ma dang*// sor mo lnga bcangs chang bu dang*// ro ldan zas mchog mtheb skyu dang*// mdangs ldan gsal ba'i mar me dang*// 'bru sna bsdus pa'i ril bu dang*// sna tshogs dar zab mdangs bkra dang*// gser dngul zangs lcags rin chen tshogs// pho rgyud mnyes pa'i chang rgod dang*// mo rgyud tshim pa'i rak+ta dang*// klu rgyud dga' ba'i dkar mngar dang*// khyad par sad 'dre tshim pa'i phyir// nas 'bras gro sran so ba dang*// yungs dkar yungs nag lo 'bras phud// ma tshang med pa nyer bsags pa// mig tu mdzes dang rna bar snyan// sna ru zhim dang kha bsod dang*// lus la 'jam phyir gzugs sgra dri// ro dang reg bya 'dod yon lnga// lha mi'i dpal 'byor sna tshogs pa// tshang bar bsags te bshams pa 'di// sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyis// sbyangs spel yid tshim longs spyod tshogs// dngos 'byor yid sprul nam mkha'i khams// yongs su bkang ste 'bul ba ni// ci dang gang gi ched ces na// bgegs chen gdong lnga pa la sogs// 'gong po sde dgu rang sder bcas// zhe sdang can gyi pho rgyud dang*// 'dod chags can gyi mo rgyud dang*// gti mug can gyi klu rgyud kyis// bsdus pa'i gnod byed 'byung po ni// sad kyi bdag po bdag mo la// dkar mo 'bras kyi glud du 'bul// bcud ldan nas kyi glud du 'bul// bda' ba gro yi glud du 'bul// shugs ldan so ba'i glud du 'bul// nag po sran ma'i glud du 'bul// snum ldan yungs kar glud du 'bul// rtsi tog sna tshogs glud du 'bul// ljon shing rtsa sngon glud du 'bul// ma smin 'bru lnga rjen zas las// lo glud 'don yon sna tshogs pa// sbyangs spel byin rlabs ya re mtshan| |dar zab mdangs bkra yid re tshim// gser dngul zangs lcags rin thang che// chang bzang rak+ta 'o ma sogs// sna tshogs btung ba ro re zhim// sha zan bza' ba bcud re che| |'jam pa'i ngag 'di zhe re gshin// bdag gi lhag bsam rnam dag ngag

/gson la longs spyod 'byor dgu 'di// dgyes par snoms la tshim par bzhes// gnod pa'i sems dang log pa yi// gang yin ma lus zhi bar mdzod// nam mkha' sprin gyi gur khang phub// bar snang na bun bla re bris// sa bzhi drod kyi lang tsho khrol// 'bras drug bcud dang ldan par gyis/ /bdag la ltos pa'i lus can rnams// mu ge dbul phong zhi bar mdzod/ /gal te de ltar zhus gsol yang*/ /'don yon tshogs la mi sems shing*| |sngags 'chang zhi ba'i ngag bcag nas// 'bras drug sad kyis 'joms byed na// mchog gsum bden pa bslus pa yi// rnam smin dmyal bar da song zhig /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po yis// 'khor lo 'bar bas mgo bo khos// gsang bdag mthu chen mthu stobs kyis// rdo rje 'bar bas klad pa chom// dbang mchog ha ya grī ba yis// thod dbyug 'bar bas yan lag chogs// dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yis// phur bu 'bar bas snying phug cig /chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral gyis// mtshon cha 'bar bas dum bur btubs| |mgo bo ardza ka ltar khos/ /klad khrag zho ltar skyom la sod/ /don snying dmar po khong nas phyung*// snying khrag thang la lhag par gyis// gzugs phung rdul phran bzhin du shig |lhu gzugs rtswa ltar khrol la zhog /rnam shes bya sgro rlung khyer ltar// rdo rje'i dmyal bar 'tshod par gyis// sngags 'chang bden pa'i sngags phyag rgya// ting 'dzin stobs kyis khyod brlag go// zhi ba'i ngag dang phan pa'i sems// khyod kyis de ring khyad bsad na// rnam smin la sogs mi bslu bas// sdug bsngal sna tshogs khyod la 'byung*// de bas de 'dra'i 'jigs pa la// legs par soms shig bka' ma gcog /dkon mchog gsum kyi bden pa dang*// yi dam zhi khro'i byin rlabs dang*// chos skyong srung ma'i mthu rtsal dang*// sngags 'chang lhag bsam dag pa'i mthus// gdon bgegs log 'dren khyod rnams kyi// ngan sems log lta kun zhi nas// phan bde zhi ba'i sems ldan zhing*// gnod gdug bsam pa ngan pa kun| |byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// lcags las grub pa'i dngul chu yis// reg pa ji bzhin der bsgyur te// 'khor ba gnas ngan 'di nyid nas// thar te byang chub mchog thob shog

|bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// 'phags pa rnams la mchod pa dang*// srung ma rnams kyi dam skong dang*// sems can rnams la phan gdags phyir// don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun// de dag 'bad med 'grub gyur cig /glud rnams rgya lam gsum mdo sogs la bskyal/ khro rgyal kyi bka' bsgo mtshams bcad/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom par bya'o/ /de skad 'bras bu me tog la/ /sad kyi nyen pa skyob pa'i phyir/ /sngags 'chang chos kyi grags pa yis/ /sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas su bris// //shu bhaṃ//
